question: Which goddess as mother of the three worlds overcomes the great demons?
premises: Durgā is called mother of the three worlds
Great demons including Mahiṣa are involved
The context implies her conquering power
inference: Durgā, mother of the three worlds, overcomes Mahiṣa and other great demons.
uncertainties: The verb of conquering is implied from context rather than explicit in this verse
plain_english: Durgā, the mother of the three worlds, overcomes Mahiṣa and other great demons.
